_readme: Curated prospect file. This is the editorial backbone the blueprint describes.
Every player here must be a real, verified roster member. Nothing in the app invents a name.
team = the school name exactly as CollegeFootballData spells it (for example 'Ohio State', 'North Dakota State', 'Miami').
draftYear = the expected draft year, not the eligibility year. tier = Established | Emerging | Future | Sleeper | Watch only.
projected = a range in words ('Round 1', 'Round 2-3', 'Day 3', 'Not yet eligible'). sourceCount = how many public boards list the player.
Until this file has entries, Draft talent and Future talent are excluded from the Scout Score and reports say 'No projections on file'.
